metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the bargain, the skins going out with Richard, and the night after.

yesterday: You are still flat. A walk, if there is one, will be at someone else's pace.
The only journey you promised is the eighteenth, because it is already set.
Looking is what you agreed to, when you can stand at a door. The house and the price wait on Anne.
Richard has the six pairs. The writing was yours. The legs were his.
